COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
03.05.2024 FA No.78 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
In Original Suit (O.S. No.411 of 
2008), filed by the respondent nos.1 to 
3-plaintiffs for partition of the suit 
property and perpetual injunction, a
preliminary decree has been passed by 
learned IInd Additional Civil Judge, 
(Senior Division), Dehradun on 
16.03.2024. 
2. Heard Mr. T.S. Bindra, learned 
counsel (through video conferencing) 
with Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
appellant. 
3. Mr. T.S. Bindra, Advocate, 
contended that the appellant-defendant 
no.1 is not a co-owner/co-sharer of the 
suit property. She has been in 
possession of the property-in dispute
since the year, 1985. The respondents￾plaintiffs are not in possession of the suit 
property and this fact has been admitted 
by the plaintiff no.1-Gurdeep Singh in his 
cross-examination. Therefore, it is a 
clear case of ouster, and the Original 
Suit, filed by the plaintiffs, is barred by  limitation. 
4. Admit. 
5. Issue notice to the respondents. 
6. Steps to be taken within a week. 
7. List on 18.06.2024. 
8. Heard on the Stay Application (IA 
No.01 of 2024). 
9. The effect and operation of the 
preliminary decree dated 16.03.2024, 
passed by learned IInd Additional Civil 
Judge, (Senior Division), Dehradun in 
Original Suit No.411 of 2008, are stayed 
till the next date of listing. 
10. The Stay Application (IA No.01 of 
2024) stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 03.05.2024
Neha
